reviews.text: Cash only?? In St Barth? Had to run to an ATM with luggage.
Car was clean and cheap, but their office was closed when our flight landed even though the site says open till 6.
Nobody at the desk spoke English and the contract was French only. We signed without really knowing the insurance terms.
Their Google pin points to a field near the airport. The actual office is behind the gas station. Add that to your website please.
We booked a Jeep online, got a tiny hatchback. 'That's what we have.'

reviews.evidence: Only accepted cash, forcing a trip to a cash machine.
Rental desk shut at arrival despite advertised evening opening.
Staff and paperwork in a single language left the insurance conditions unclear.
Map location is wrong; real office sits elsewhere near the fuel station.
Reserved vehicle was swapped for a smaller model without notice.
